items.title: 3.9 Bond energy aur bond length (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.9, printed pages 67-69.

blocks.title: Bond energy
blocks.text: Bond energy kisi madde ke ek mole mein kisi khas qism ke sab bonds torne ke liye darkar energy ki ausat miqdar hai. Yeh kimiyai taamul mein shamil hararat naap kar tajurbati taur par tai hoti hai, aur us ki unit kJ fi mol hai.

Bond energy bond ki mazbooti aur us ki reactivity ka paimana hai. Bond ki mazbooti bandhe hue atoms ke electronegativity farq aur atoms ke size par munhasir hai. H-X compounds mein, jahan X F, Cl, Br ya I hai, bond energy bandhe hue atoms ke barhte electronegativity farq ke saath barhti hai: jaise farq barhta hai bond polarity zyada hoti hai, jo atoms ko bandhne ke liye izafi kashish deti hai. Isi liye HF ki bond energy (565 kJ fi mol) HI (295 kJ fi mol) se zyada hai. Multiple bonds ki energies single bonds se zyada hain: C triple bond C > C=C > C-C.

blocks.caption: Chune hue bonds ki ausat bond energies kJ fi mol mein (Table 3.2)

blocks.title: Bond length
blocks.text: Bond length covalent bond banane wale do atoms ke nuclei ke darmiyan fasla hai. Yeh electron diffraction, X-ray diffraction ya spectral mutale jaisi tabee techniques se tajurbati taur par tai hoti hai.

Bond length bohat se awamil par munhasir hai, electronegativity, size aur covalent bond ki nau'iyat (single, double ya triple) samet. Atoms ka size barhne se covalent bond length barhti hai: C-Cl bond taqreeban 180 pm hai jabke C-F 135 pm, kyunke chlorine atom kahin bara hai. Bandhe hue atoms ke electronegativity farq barhne se bond chhota hota hai: SiF4 mein Si-F bond length taqreeban 155 pm payi gayi, jabke Si (117 pm) aur F (64 pm) ke covalent radii se hisab 181 pm deta hai. Electronegativity farq covalent bond ko ionic kirdar deta hai, aur bandhe hue atoms ke darmiyan izafi kashish bond ko chhota karti hai.

blocks.caption: Chune hue bonds ki bond lengths picometres mein (Table 3.3)

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: H-F 565 se H-I 295 tak girti chaar neeli bars. Oopar darmiyan: C-C 347 se carbon triple bond 839 tak barhti teen sabz bars un ki lengths 154, 133 aur 120 pm ke saath. Oopar daen: bond length aur size par notes. Neeche: ufqi bars jo NaCl ke ionic bond 760 ka O-H bond 464, metallic bond, hydrogen bonding, dipole-dipole aur van der Waals forces se muqabla karti hain.
blocks.caption: Bond energy, bond length aur bonds aur intermolecular forces ki nisbati mazbooti (Tables 3.2 se 3.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: H-X bond energy HF se HI tak girti hai jaise electronegativity farq, aur yun polarity, ghatta hai. Ek jaise atoms ke darmiyan multiple bonds single bonds se mazboot aur chhote hain. Bare atoms lambe bonds dete hain (C-F se C-I), aur bara electronegativity farq chhota bond deta hai, jaise Si-F 155 pm covalent radii se 181 pm ke muqable. Neeche ka chart ionic bond sab se mazboot, phir covalent, phir metallic dikhata hai, aur hydrogen bonds, dipole-dipole aur London forces kahin kamzor.

blocks.prompt: HI zyada mazboot acid aur mazboot reducing agent hai jabke HF kamzor acid; aur acetylene (triple bond) ethene (double bond) se zyada mustahkam hai. Dono ki bond energies se wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: H-I bond energy sirf 295 kJ fi mol hai jabke H-F ki 565, to H-I kahin asani se tootta hai: woh H+ asani se chhorta hai (mazboot acid) aur apna hydrogen ya electrons asani se deta hai (reducing agent), jabke mazboot H-F bond apna hydrogen pakre rakhta hai. C triple C bond (839 kJ fi mol) C=C (614 kJ fi mol) se mazboot aur chhota hai (120 pm banam 133 pm), to acetylene ka bond torne ke liye ethene se zyada energy chahiye.

items: Bond energy (kJ fi mol) ek mole bond torne ki ausat energy hai aur mazbooti napti hai; yeh electronegativity farq (HF 565 > HI 295) aur bond ki tadaad (C triple C 839 > C=C 614 > C-C 347) ke saath barhti hai.
Bond length (pm) nuclei ka fasla hai; yeh atomic size ke saath barhti hai (C-F 135, C-Cl 180, C-I 214) aur electronegativity farq ke saath ghatti hai (Si-F 155 napi hui banam radii se 181).
